verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָּל־ צָר֖וּעַ וְכָל־ זָ֑ב וְכֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָנָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wî·šal·lə·ḥū min- ham·ma·ḥă·neh kāl- ṣā·rū·a‘ wə·ḵāl zāḇ wə·ḵōl ṭā·mê lā·nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Command - the Israelites . . . to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease anyone who has a bodily discharge and anyone who is defiled by a dead body

verses.original: תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל־ מִזָּכָ֤ר עַד־ נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּם מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה וְלֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ מַ֣חֲנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šal·lê·ḥū ’el- miz·zā·ḵār ‘aḏ- nə·qê·ḇāh tə·šal·lə·ḥūm mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·lō yə·ṭam·mə·’ū ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nê·hem ’ă·šer ’ă·nî šō·ḵên bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: You must send away . . . male and female alike send them outside the camp so they will not defile - their camp where I dwell among them

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֙ וַיְשַׁלְּח֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ עָשׂ֖וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên way·šal·lə·ḥū ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·śū ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’el- dib·ber mō·šeh kên
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . did this sending [such people] vvv outside the camp [They] . . . did just as the LORD . . . had instructed Moses . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ כִּ֤י אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־ אִשָּׁ֗ה לִמְעֹ֥ל מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָ֑ה יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִכָּל־ חַטֹּ֣את הָֽאָדָ֔ם הַהִֽוא׃ הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְאָֽשְׁמָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî ’îš ’ōw- ’iš·šāh lim·‘ōl ma·‘al Yah·weh ya·‘ă·śū mik·kāl ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ hā·’ā·ḏām ha·hi·w han·ne·p̄eš wə·’ā·šə·māh
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites that . . . when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another that person is guilty

verses.original: וְהִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת־ חַטָּאתָם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־ אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף וַחֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַ֕ן לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·wad·dū ’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū wə·hê·šîḇ ’eṯ- ’ă·šā·mōw bə·rō·šōw yō·sêp̄ wa·ḥă·mî·ši·ṯōw ‘ā·lāw wə·nā·ṯan la·’ă·šer ’ā·šam lōw
verses.literal: and must confess - the sin - he has committed He must make full restitution - - . . . add a fifth to its value and give all this to the one he has wronged

verses.original: וְאִם־ לָאִ֜ישׁ אֵ֨ין גֹּאֵ֗ל לְהָשִׁ֤יב הָאָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔יו הָאָשָׁ֛ם הַמּוּשָׁ֥ב לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִלְּבַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־ בּ֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lā·’îš ’ên gō·’êl lə·hā·šîḇ hā·’ā·šām ’ê·lāw hā·’ā·šām ham·mū·šāḇ Yah·weh lak·kō·hên mil·lə·ḇaḏ ’êl hak·kip·pu·rîm ’ă·šer yə·ḵap·per- bōw ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong . . . vvv the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement by which the atonement is made for him

verses.original: וְכָל־ קָדְשֵׁ֧י תְּרוּמָ֞ה לְכָל־ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן יִהְיֶֽה׃ ל֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl qā·ḏə·šê tə·rū·māh lə·ḵāl ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- yaq·rî·ḇū lak·kō·hên yih·yeh lōw
verses.literal: Every sacred contribution . . . the Israelites . . . - bring to the priest shall belong to him

verses.original: וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ קֳדָשָׁ֖יו ל֣וֹ יִהְי֑וּ אֲשֶׁר־ אִ֛ישׁ יִתֵּ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן יִהְיֶֽה׃פ ל֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’eṯ- qo·ḏā·šāw lōw yih·yū ’ă·šer- ’îš yit·tên lak·kō·hên yih·yeh lōw
verses.literal: Each man’s - sacred gifts are his own - [but] whatever [he] gives to the priest will belong to [the priest]

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ תִשְׂטֶ֣ה וּמָעֲלָ֥ה ב֖וֹ מָֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî- ’îš ’îš ’iš·tōw ṯiś·ṭeh ū·mā·‘ă·lāh ḇōw mā·‘al
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them that . . . if any man’s . . . wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

verses.original: וְשָׁכַ֨ב אִ֣ישׁ אֹתָהּ֮ שִׁכְבַת־ זֶרַע֒ וְנֶעְלַם֙ מֵעֵינֵ֣י אִישָׁ֔הּ וְהִ֣יא נִטְמָ֑אָה וְנִסְתְּרָ֖ה אֵ֣ין וְעֵד֙ בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א נִתְפָּֽשָׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḵaḇ ’îš ’ō·ṯāh šiḵ·ḇaṯ- ze·ra‘ wə·ne‘·lam mê·‘ê·nê ’î·šāh wə·hî niṭ·mā·’āh wə·nis·tə·rāh ’ên wə·‘êḏ bāh wə·hi·w lō niṯ·pā·śāh
verses.literal: by sleeping with another man . . . . . . . . . and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected since there is no witness against her - and she was not caught in the act

verses.original: רֽוּחַ־ קִנְאָ֛ה וְעָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧יו וְקִנֵּ֥א אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְהִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה אוֹ־ רֽוּחַ־ קִנְאָה֙ עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֤יו וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהִ֖יא לֹ֥א נִטְמָֽאָה׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ- qin·’āh wə·‘ā·ḇar ‘ā·lāw wə·qin·nê ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·hi·w niṭ·mā·’āh ’ōw- rū·aḥ- qin·’āh ‘ā·ḇar ‘ā·lāw wə·qin·nê ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·hî lō niṭ·mā·’āh
verses.literal: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over [her husband] and he suspects - his wife who has defiled herself or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects - her even though she has not defiled herself

verses.original: הָאִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ וְהֵבִ֨יא אִשְׁתּוֹ֮ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־ עָלֶ֔יהָ קָרְבָּנָהּ֙ עֲשִׂירִ֥ת הָאֵיפָ֖ה שְׂעֹרִ֑ים קֶ֣מַח לֹֽא־ יִצֹ֨ק שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹֽא־ עָלָ֜יו יִתֵּ֤ן לְבֹנָ֔ה עָלָיו֙ כִּֽי־ ה֔וּא מִנְחַ֤ת קְנָאֹת֙ מִנְחַ֥ת זִכָּר֖וֹן מַזְכֶּ֥רֶת עָוֺֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš ’eṯ- wə·hê·ḇî ’iš·tōw ’el- hak·kō·hên wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- ‘ā·le·hā qā·rə·bā·nāh ‘ă·śî·riṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh śə·‘ō·rîm qe·maḥ lō- yi·ṣōq še·men wə·lō- ‘ā·lāw yit·tên lə·ḇō·nāh ‘ā·lāw kî- hū min·ḥaṯ qə·nā·’ōṯ min·ḥaṯ zik·kā·rō·wn maz·ke·reṯ ‘ā·wōn
verses.literal: then [he] - is to bring his wife to the priest He must also bring - for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour He is not to pour oil . . . over it or put frankincense on it because it is a grain offering for jealousy an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ וְהֶֽעֱמִדָ֖הּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯāh wə·he·‘ĕ·mi·ḏāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest is to bring [the wife] forward - and have her stand before the LORD

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְלָקַ֧ח קְדֹשִׁ֖ים מַ֥יִם חָ֑רֶשׂ בִּכְלִי־ יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנָתַ֥ן וּמִן־ הֶֽעָפָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּקַרְקַ֣ע אֶל־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ qə·ḏō·šîm ma·yim ḥā·reś biḵ·lî- yiq·qaḥ hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯan ū·min- he·‘ā·p̄ār ’ă·šer yih·yeh ham·miš·kān bə·qar·qa‘ ’el- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then [he] is to take [some] holy water in a clay jar - - and put some of the dust - - from the tabernacle floor into the water

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־ הָאִשָּׁה֮ וְהֶעֱמִ֨יד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וּפָרַע֙ אֶת־ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה רֹ֣אשׁ וְנָתַ֣ן עַל־ כַּפֶּ֗יהָ אֵ֚ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַזִּכָּר֔וֹן הִ֑וא מִנְחַ֥ת קְנָאֹ֖ת הַכֹּהֵן֙ יִהְי֔וּ וּבְיַ֤ד הַמָּרִ֖ים מֵ֥י הַמְאָֽרֲרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·ra‘ ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh rōš wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- kap·pe·hā ’êṯ min·ḥaṯ haz·zik·kā·rō·wn hî min·ḥaṯ qə·nā·’ōṯ hak·kō·hên yih·yū ū·ḇə·yaḏ ham·mā·rîm mê ham·’ā·ră·rîm
verses.literal: After the priest - has the woman stand before the LORD he is to let down - her hair and place in her hands - the grain offering of memorial which is the grain offering for jealousy The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אֹתָ֜הּ וְאָמַ֤ר אֶל־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אִם־ לֹ֨א אִישׁ֙ אֹתָ֔ךְ שָׁכַ֥ב וְאִם־ לֹ֥א שָׂטִ֛ית טֻמְאָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת אִישֵׁ֑ךְ הִנָּקִ֕י הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ הַמָּרִ֥ים מִמֵּ֛י הַֽמְאָרֲרִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hiš·bî·a‘ ’ō·ṯāh wə·’ā·mar ’el- hā·’iš·šāh ’im- lō ’îš ’ō·ṯāḵ šā·ḵaḇ wə·’im- lō śā·ṭîṯ ṭum·’āh ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šêḵ hin·nā·qî hā·’êl·leh ham·mā·rîm mim·mê ham·’ā·ră·rîm
verses.literal: And [he] is to put the woman under oath - and say to her If no other man . . . has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse

verses.original: כִּ֥י וְאַ֗תְּ שָׂטִ֛ית תַּ֥חַת אִישֵׁ֖ךְ וְכִ֣י נִטְמֵ֑את וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שְׁכָבְתּ֔וֹ אִ֥ישׁ בָּךְ֙ אֶת־ מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֖י אִישֵֽׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî wə·’at śā·ṭîṯ ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šêḵ wə·ḵî niṭ·mêṯ way·yit·tên šə·ḵā·ḇə·tōw ’îš bāḵ ’eṯ- mib·bal·‘ă·ḏê ’î·šêḵ
verses.literal: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man - other than your husband

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֮ וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ בִּשְׁבֻעַ֣ת הָאָלָה֒ הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְאָמַ֤ר לָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה יְהוָ֥ה יִתֵּ֨ן אוֹתָ֛ךְ לְאָלָ֥ה וְלִשְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑ךְ יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ בְּתֵ֨ת יְרֵכֵךְ֙ נֹפֶ֔לֶת וְאֶת־ בִּטְנֵ֖ךְ צָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh wə·hiš·bî·a‘ biš·ḇu·‘aṯ hā·’ā·lāh hak·kō·hên wə·’ā·mar lā·’iš·šāh Yah·weh yit·tên ’ō·w·ṯāḵ lə·’ā·lāh wə·liš·ḇu·‘āh bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mêḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- bə·ṯêṯ yə·rê·ḵêḵ nō·p̄e·leṯ wə·’eṯ- biṭ·nêḵ ṣā·ḇāh
verses.literal: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse - - - then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people - by making your thigh shrivel - and your belly swell

verses.original: הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמַּ֨יִם הַמְאָרְרִ֤ים וּ֠בָאוּ בְּֽמֵעַ֔יִךְ בֶּ֖טֶן לַצְבּ֥וֹת יָרֵ֑ךְ וְלַנְפִּ֣ל הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְאָמְרָ֥ה אָמֵ֥ן׀ אָמֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl·leh ham·ma·yim ham·’ā·rə·rîm ū·ḇā·’ū bə·mê·‘a·yiḵ be·ṭen laṣ·bō·wṯ yā·rêḵ wə·lan·pil hā·’iš·šāh wə·’ā·mə·rāh ’ā·mên ’ā·mên
verses.literal: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel Then the woman is to say Amen Amen

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְ֠כָתַב אֶת־ הָאֵ֛לֶּה הָאָלֹ֥ת בַּסֵּ֑פֶר וּמָחָ֖ה אֶל־ הַמָּרִֽים׃ מֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ ’eṯ- hā·’êl·leh hā·’ā·lōṯ bas·sê·p̄er ū·mā·ḥāh ’el- ham·mā·rîm mê
verses.literal: And the priest shall write - these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water

verses.original: הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־ וְהִשְׁקָה֙ אֶת־ הַמָּרִ֖ים מֵ֥י הַמְאָֽרֲרִ֑ים הַמַּ֥יִם וּבָ֥אוּ בָ֛הּ לְמָרִֽים׃ הַֽמְאָרֲרִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- ham·mā·rîm mê ham·’ā·ră·rîm ham·ma·yim ū·ḇā·’ū ḇāh lə·mā·rîm ham·’ā·ră·rîm
verses.literal: He is to have the woman - drink - the bitter water that brings a curse and it will enter her and may cause her bitter suffering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְלָקַ֤ח הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִיַּ֣ד מִנְחַ֣ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת וְהֵנִ֤יף אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ hā·’iš·šāh ’êṯ mî·yaḏ min·ḥaṯ haq·qə·nā·’ōṯ wə·hê·nîp̄ ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯāh ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: The priest shall take from [her] - hand the grain offering for jealousy wave - [it] before the LORD and bring - it to the altar

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וְקָמַ֨ץ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־ אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְאַחַ֛ר הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־ יַשְׁקֶ֥ה אֶת־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·qā·maṣ min- ham·min·ḥāh ’eṯ- ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh wə·’a·ḥar hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- yaš·qeh ’eṯ- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering - as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar after that he is to have the woman - drink - the water

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקָ֣הּ אֶת־ הַמַּ֗יִם וְהָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם־ נִטְמְאָה֮ וַתִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּאִישָׁהּ֒ הַמַּ֤יִם הַמְאָֽרֲרִים֙ וּבָ֨אוּ בָ֜הּ לְמָרִ֔ים בִטְנָ֔הּ וְצָבְתָ֣ה יְרֵכָ֑הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְהָיְתָ֧ה הָאִשָּׁ֛ה לְאָלָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ’im- niṭ·mə·’āh wat·tim·‘ōl ma·‘al bə·’î·šāh ham·ma·yim ham·’ā·ră·rîm ū·ḇā·’ū ḇāh lə·mā·rîm ḇiṭ·nāh wə·ṣā·ḇə·ṯāh yə·rê·ḵāh wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh hā·’iš·šāh lə·’ā·lāh bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh
verses.literal: When he has made her drink - the water if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful . . . to her husband then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering her belly will swell her thigh will shrivel and she will become . . . accursed among her people

verses.original: וְאִם־ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה לֹ֤א נִטְמְאָה֙ וּטְהֹרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְנִקְּתָ֖ה וְנִזְרְעָ֥ה זָֽרַע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hā·’iš·šāh lō niṭ·mə·’āh ū·ṭə·hō·rāh hî wə·niq·qə·ṯāh wə·niz·rə·‘āh zā·ra‘
verses.literal: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean she will be unaffected and able to conceive children

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִשָּׁ֛ה תִּשְׂטֶ֥ה וְנִטְמָֽאָה׃ תַּ֥חַת אִישָׁ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ haq·qə·nā·’ōṯ ’ă·šer ’iš·šāh tiś·ṭeh wə·niṭ·mā·’āh ta·ḥaṯ ’î·šāh
verses.literal: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority

verses.original: א֣וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה תַּעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֛יו אִ֗ישׁ וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֶת־ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֵ֥ת וְעָ֤שָׂה לָהּ֙ הַזֹּֽאת׃ כָּל־ הַתּוֹרָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ’ă·šer rū·aḥ qin·’āh ta·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ā·lāw ’îš wə·qin·nê ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw hā·’iš·šāh wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ ’eṯ- lip̄·nê Yah·weh hak·kō·hên ’êṯ wə·‘ā·śāh lāh haz·zōṯ kāl- hat·tō·w·rāh
verses.literal: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over . . . a husband and he suspects - his wife He is to have the woman stand - before the LORD and the priest - is to apply to her this entire law

verses.original: הָאִ֖ישׁ וְנִקָּ֥ה מֵעָוֺ֑ן הַהִ֔וא וְהָאִשָּׁ֣ה תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת־ עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš wə·niq·qāh mê·‘ā·wōn ha·hi·w wə·hā·’iš·šāh tiś·śā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nāh
verses.literal: The husband will be free from guilt but the woman shall bear her iniquity
